description: Create a subscription plan for an agent. WRITE operation. period is one of "day" | "week" | "month" | "quarter" | "year"; planType 0=subscription (default), 1=usage-based, 2=hybrid.

chain.description: Chain: "bsc" (default) | "ethereum" | "base". Sepolia testnet is not supported.

maxUsage.description: Max usage per billing period (0 = unlimited)

payToken.description: ERC20 token address; omit for native ETH

price.description: Recurring price in wei/token units (required unless planType=1)

usagePrice.description: Per-use price (required when planType is 1 or 2)

name: actora_subscription_create_plan
title: Create Subscription Plan
